[[File:MandoRoyalGuard-TCWCE.png|thumb|right|180px|A royal guard with force staff]]
A '''Force staff''' was a [[Staff/Legends|staff]]-like [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] capable of deflecting [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts and applying [[Stun/Legends|stun]] pulses. They were the favored weapon used by the [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|Mandalorian Royal Guard]] when called upon to defend the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] [[Duke/Legends|duchess]], [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]].
